notes: "Here is one change from start to finish, in the public example project. The Story for this slide said: shorten the title and the explanation, and keep the layout, every other object and the main message. On the left is the slide before; on the right, after. The table below lists exactly what changed: the title and the lead sentence. The Purpose and Keep columns, the footer and the geometry are untouched. The change was proposed as a transaction, previewed, and then applied through the shared writer, so it is recorded and can be reviewed on the next slide. The same discipline applies to a scientific slide: an edit to the 1BNA chart title must not touch the data or the citation."

designIntent.purpose: Show one requested change, before and after, with an exact diff table.
keep: Diff table matches the captured text
designIntent.requestedChange: Story-driven rework: organise the founder's reasons for building HUANDENG and show the features that answer them.
designIntent.source: Owner's spoken story, 11 Nov 2026 (sources/story/USER-STORY.zh-CN.md); facts in sources/story/FACTS.md
